title: eludite.navigation.call_hierarchy input
description: View Call Hierarchy (Ctrl+K, Ctrl+T): show the member at `line`, `column` (or the caret) in the Call Hierarchy window with its "Calls To" and "Calls From" folders (`textDocument/prepareCallHierarchy`, `callHierarchy/incomingCalls`, `callHierarchy/outgoingCalls`); expand a node's folder, or navigate to a node or one of its call sites.

path.description: Absolute path of an open document. Omit to act on the active document.

expand.description: Expand node `expand` (its folder `direction`) instead of starting again.

navigate.description: Open node `navigate` (its call site `site` when given).

site.description: With `navigate`: the call site (0-based in the node's `sites`).
